supports: Neara publicly describes a US utility risk-prioritization case study with projected SAIDI reduction.
The case study frames risk prioritization as unifying GIS, LiDAR, inspection, and vegetation data into a defensible model.
The case study connects risk scoring to capital planning, planning confidence, and system-wide decision-making.
limits: The case study is not identified as SCE.
The case study does not validate the demo's synthetic watch-point count.
